summary: A wooden dresser with 8 drawers. You build two side frames, a middle divider and rails, then add the top and back, fix it to the wall and build and insert the 8 drawers with the anti-tip drawer interlock.
tools: Drill with 8 mm and 3 mm bits (for wall fixing)
unclear: Which posts are front or back (L1/L2, R1/R2) is guessed.
Exact board sizes are estimated from drawings; no dimensions are printed.
Positions of the 11 top cam screws/locks (steps 32, 36) and the 4 screws in step 35 are approximate.
Runner part number for divider panels (steps 27-28) is not printed; assumed 10085261.
Mounting of the drawer support bar 10054466 (steps 61-62) is hard to read.
Drawer insertion order in the right column (steps 73-74) is not fully shown.
Whether the back panel is two halves or one board with a seam line is uncertain.
Runner screws (107716, 108462, 10080579) only fix the metal runners to one board; they do not join a second board, so the 'no board behind' warnings for them are expected.
Knob screws 119976 go through the drawer front into the knob, not into another board.
The screws in step 20 (100214) and step 30 (100232) go down through the top front rail and are later hidden under the top; the 3D view may show them inside the top.
Where the 4 screws 100214 in step 35 go up into the top (through which board) cannot be read; their positions are approximate.
How the drawer support bar 10054466 and its small screws 105344 sit on the drawer front and back (steps 61-62) is hard to read; positions are a guess.
Drawer sides sit close to the top-row dividers; the runner gap is not modelled exactly.
The 4 screws 100214 in step 35 are now shown going up through the front top rail into the top. The manual does not show this clearly, so their exact boards and positions are a guess.

steps.title: Fit cam screws in the posts
steps.text: Lay posts L1, L2, R2 and R1 on a soft surface as shown, checking the labels. Screw 3 cam screws into the holes on the inner side of each post.
steps.tip: Screw in only until the collar touches the wood; do not crush the plastic sleeve.

steps.title: Join posts to the side panels
steps.text: Push 2 short dowels into each post. Fit a side panel between each pair of posts.
steps.tip: Use the short dowels 101350 here, not the long 101353.

steps.title: Lock the side frames
steps.text: Push 6 cam locks into each side panel over the cam screws and turn them clockwise to lock.

steps.title: Fit the interlock rails
steps.text: Press 3 long dowels into each side panel and push an interlock rail onto them, mechanism facing as shown.
steps.tip: Check the interlock mechanism faces the way shown in the close-up.

steps.title: Runners on the right frame
steps.text: Screw 3 runners marked IKEA CR to the right side frame, 2 screws 107716 each.
steps.tip: Use screws 107716 only; the others look similar.

steps.title: Runners on the left frame
steps.text: Screw 3 runners marked IKEA CL to the left side frame, 2 screws 107716 each.
steps.tip: CL goes on the left frame, CR on the right.

steps.title: Fit floor glides
steps.text: Press a floor glide into the bottom end of each of the 4 posts.
steps.tip: There are left and right glides; match the shape to the post as shown.

steps.title: Cam screws for the rails
steps.text: Screw 5 cam screws into the inner side of each side frame (10 in total).
steps.tip: Screw them fully in; none may stick up with the sleeve gap shown crossed out.

steps.title: Dowels in the rails
steps.text: Push one dowel into each end of the 7 rails (14 dowels).

steps.title: Stand two short rails on the right frame
steps.text: With the right frame lying flat, inner side up, push two short rails onto their cam screws.

steps.title: Add two long rails
steps.text: Push the two long rails onto the right frame.

steps.title: Add the front bottom rail
steps.text: Push the widest long rail onto the right frame, finished side facing out as shown.

steps.title: Lock the rails to the right frame
steps.text: Fit 5 cam locks in the rails and turn them clockwise.

steps.title: Middle divider: first runners
steps.text: Lay the three divider boards side by side as shown. Screw on 3 runners marked IKEA CL with 3 screws 108462 each.

steps.title: Middle divider: second runners
steps.text: Turn the divider over and screw on 3 runners marked IKEA CR with 3 screws 108462 each.

steps.title: Double cam screws
steps.text: Turn the divider up and screw in the 4 double cam screws from the strip.

steps.title: Dowel in divider end
steps.text: Push 1 dowel into the end hole of the divider as shown.

steps.title: Dowel in other end
steps.text: Push 1 dowel into the hole at the other end.

steps.title: Place the middle divider
steps.text: Lower the middle divider onto the two short rails.

steps.title: Fix the divider
steps.text: Drive 3 screws 100214 through the long rails into the divider with the Allen key. Lock the 2 short rails with 2 cam locks.
steps.tip: Use the thick light screw 100214, not the black 100232.

steps.title: Add the other short rails
steps.text: Push two short rails onto the divider.

steps.title: Lock the short rails
steps.text: Fit 2 cam locks and turn them clockwise.

steps.title: Fit the left frame
steps.text: Lower the left side frame onto the rails, inner side down.
steps.warn: Two people: the frame is large.

steps.title: Lock the left frame
steps.text: Fit 5 cam locks in the rails and turn them clockwise.

steps.title: Fit the adjustable foot
steps.text: Screw the adjustable foot into the bottom end of the middle divider.

steps.title: Stand the frame up
steps.text: Carefully tip the frame upright onto its legs.

steps.title: Divider runners (CR)
steps.text: On each of the 2 small divider panels, screw a runner marked IKEA CR with 2 screws 108462.
steps.tip: Keep the curved cut-out where the drawing shows it.

steps.title: Divider runners (CL)
steps.text: Turn each panel over and screw a runner marked IKEA CL with 2 screws 108462.

steps.title: Dowel in the dividers
steps.text: Push 1 dowel into the top edge of each divider panel.

steps.title: Fix the top-row dividers
steps.text: Place a divider in the middle of each top drawer opening. Fix each with 1 long black screw 100232 from above and 1 screw 100214 from below.
steps.tip: Black 100232 goes in from the top, light 100214 from below; do not swap them.

steps.title: Brackets on the top
steps.text: Turn the top upside down. Screw the 2 wall brackets to the back edge with a washer and screw 109049 each.

steps.title: Cam screws in the top
steps.text: Screw 11 cam screws into the underside of the top.

steps.title: Dowels on the sides
steps.text: Push 3 dowels into the top edge of each side panel.

steps.title: Place the top
steps.text: Lower the top onto the frame, brackets at the back.

steps.title: Screw the top from below
steps.text: Drive 4 screws 100214 up into the top with the Allen key.

steps.title: Lock the top
steps.text: Fit 11 cam locks and turn them clockwise.

steps.title: Lay on the front and place the back
steps.text: Lay the dresser on its front on a soft surface, propped as shown. Lay the back panel halves in place and draw a pencil line along the middle shelf edge.
steps.warn: Two people to turn the dresser.

steps.title: Mark the middle divider
steps.text: Mark where the middle divider is at both edges and draw a line between the marks.

steps.title: First nail
steps.text: Square the back and hammer 1 nail in one top corner.

steps.title: Second nail
steps.text: Push the back into line and hammer 1 nail in the other corner.
steps.tip: Check the frame is square before nailing.

steps.title: Third nail
steps.text: Push the back flush and hammer 1 nail on the other edge.

steps.title: Nail the back
steps.text: Hammer in the remaining 27 nails along the edges and the pencil lines. Then stand the dresser up.
steps.tip: Follow the pencil lines so the nails hit the divider.
steps.warn: Two people to stand it up.

steps.title: Mark the wall
steps.text: Read the wall-fixing leaflet. Place the dresser against the wall and mark the hole positions through the 2 brackets.
steps.warn: This dresser must be fixed to the wall to prevent tipping.

steps.title: Move the dresser away
steps.text: Move the dresser away from the wall to drill at the 2 marks.

steps.title: Drill the wall
steps.text: Solid wall: drill 8 mm, 70 mm deep and tap in a plug. Hollow wall: drill 8 mm, about 30 mm deep, plug. Solid wood: drill 3 mm, no plug.
steps.tip: Not sure of your wall? Get professional advice.
steps.warn: Check for hidden pipes and cables before drilling.

steps.title: Screw to the wall
steps.text: Push the dresser back and screw each bracket to the wall with a washer and screw 109567.
steps.warn: Always fix to the wall to prevent tip-over.

steps.title: Small drawers: fronts
steps.text: For each of the 4 small drawers, lay the front face down and screw in 4 cam screws 123492.

steps.title: Small drawers: dowels in sides
steps.text: Push 2 dowels 101345 into the front end of each side.

steps.title: Small drawers: fit sides
steps.text: Stand 2 sides on each front over the cam screws. The side with the warning label goes as shown.
steps.tip: Groove for the bottom must face inward.

steps.title: Small drawers: lock sides
steps.text: Fit 4 cam locks per drawer and turn clockwise.

steps.title: Small drawers: bottom
steps.text: Slide the fibreboard bottom into the grooves, smooth side inward.

steps.title: Small drawers: back
steps.text: Place the back between the sides and hammer in 4 ribbed nails 110519.

steps.title: Small drawers: runners
steps.text: Clip a drawer runner under each side and fix with 2 screws 10080579 (4 per drawer).

steps.title: Small drawers: knob
steps.text: Fit 1 knob to each front with screw 119976 from the inside.

steps.title: Medium and large drawers: fronts
steps.text: Lay each of the 4 wide fronts face down and screw in 4 cam screws 123492.

steps.title: Dowels in sides
steps.text: Push 2 dowels 101345 into the front end of each side.

steps.title: Fit sides
steps.text: Stand the sides on the fronts over the cam screws.
steps.tip: Medium sides go with medium fronts, tall with tall.

steps.title: Lock sides
steps.text: Fit 4 cam locks per drawer and turn clockwise.

steps.title: Bottoms
steps.text: Slide the fibreboard bottoms into the grooves.

steps.title: Backs
steps.text: Place the backs and hammer in ribbed nails: 4 per medium drawer, 6 per large drawer.
steps.tip: Large drawers take 6 nails, medium take 4.

steps.title: Support bar
steps.text: Fix one end of the support bar with 1 screw 105344.

steps.title: Fix the support bar
steps.text: Swing the bar up and fix the other end with 1 screw 105344.

steps.title: Runners
steps.text: Clip a runner under each side and fix with 2 screws 10080579 (4 per drawer).

steps.title: Knobs
steps.text: Fit 2 knobs to each front with screws 119976 from the inside.

steps.title: Release first interlock catch
steps.text: Flip the interlock catch for the top-left drawer down as shown.

steps.title: Insert top-left small drawer
steps.text: Tilt the small drawer in on its runners and push it closed.
steps.tip: Never open more than one drawer at a time.

steps.title: Next catch
steps.text: Flip the next interlock catch.

steps.title: Insert second small drawer
steps.text: Insert the next small drawer and push it closed.

steps.title: Flip 2 catches
steps.text: Flip 2 interlock catches as shown.

steps.title: Insert large drawer
steps.text: Insert the large drawer at the bottom left and push it closed.

steps.title: Flip 2 catches
steps.text: Flip 2 more interlock catches.

steps.title: Insert medium drawer
steps.text: Insert the medium drawer in the left middle row.

steps.title: Flip last catches
steps.text: Flip the last 2 interlock catches.

steps.title: Insert remaining drawers
steps.text: Insert the remaining drawers in the right column and push them closed. Check that only one drawer opens at a time.
steps.tip: If a catch is set wrong, see the help page to release it and remove the drawer.
